description: Partnerize S2S and clickref conversion URLs on prf.hn/conversion, whose campaign, clickref, currency, and basket keys ride as colon-delimited path segments. The loader on cdn.performancehorizon.com is not contracted.

params.name: campaign
params.description: It is the Partnerize campaign id, written as campaign:{CAMPAIGNID} on the conversion path.
params.fix_hint: Put the campaign id from Partnerize in the path as campaign:{id}.

params.name: clickref
params.description: It is the click reference captured at the landing page. Partnerize documents it as required for attributed conversions. Exclusive-code tracking may send it blank; that still fails attribution.
params.fix_hint: Replay the stored clickref in the path as clickref:{value}.

params.name: currency
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of the conversion. Partnerize documents it as required when the event has a monetary value.
params.fix_hint: Put a three-letter currency code in the path as currency:GBP.

params.name: conversionref
params.description: It is the brand's unique conversion reference. Partnerize documents it as required for validation, and says omit it when the brand cannot generate one.
params.fix_hint: Put a stable order id in the path as conversionref:{id}, or omit the pair and let Partnerize mint one.

params.name: tmethod
params.description: It is the tracking method. Partnerize documents `tmethod:2` on S2S conversion URLs.

params.name: tplatform
params.description: It is the tracking platform. Partnerize documents `tplatform:2` on S2S conversion URLs.

params.name: tracking_mode
params.description: It is the tracking mode. Partnerize S2S samples send `tracking_mode:api`.

params.name: country
params.description: It is the site country of the purchase. Partnerize documents ISO 3166 letter country codes.
params.fix_hint: Send a two-letter ISO 3166-1 code, such as `GB`.

params.name: customertype
params.description: It is whether the buyer is a first-time or repeat customer. Partnerize documents `new` or `existing`, and says leave the pair blank when the value is unknown.
params.fix_hint: Send `customertype:new` or `customertype:existing`, or leave the value blank.

params.name: voucher
params.description: It is the voucher used at purchase. Partnerize documents that the item `value` must already reflect the discount.
params.fix_hint: Send the voucher code, or leave the pair blank.

params.name: fulfilment_date
params.description: It is the service delivery date. Partnerize documents `YYYY-MM-DD`.

params.name: fulfilment_start_date
params.description: It is the start of the fulfilment period. Partnerize documents `YYYY-MM-DD`.

params.name: conversion_time
params.description: It is the conversion timestamp. Partnerize samples use `YYYY-MM-DD+HH:MM:SS`.

params.name: device
params.description: It is the converting device. Partnerize documents `bot`, `desktop`, `mobile`, `tablet`, and `Other`.
params.fix_hint: Send `device:mobile` or another documented device value.

params.name: context
params.description: It is the converting context. Partnerize documents `web`, `m_web`, `m_app`, `in_app`, `cd_d`, `cd_p`, `other`, and `offline`.
params.fix_hint: Send `context:m_web` or another documented context value.

params.name: category
params.description: It is the item category inside a basket container. Partnerize documents `category` as required on each `[...]` item.

params.name: sku
params.description: It is the item product code inside a basket container.
params.fix_hint: Put `sku:{code}` inside the basket container, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: value
params.description: It is the individual item value, excluding tax, delivery, and currency symbols. Partnerize multiplies it by `quantity`.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `19.99`, with no currency symbol or comma.

params.name: quantity
params.description: It is the item quantity inside a basket container. Partnerize documents a positive number.
params.fix_hint: Send a positive integer in `quantity`, such as `1`.

rules.message: A path segment carries what looks like a raw email address. Partnerize forbids personal data that could identify the end user in conversion parameters.
rules.fix_hint: Drop the email from the conversion path. Use `conversionref` for the order id.
